theorems.name: Submission.dor_ims_lusin_measurable_continuousOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) {Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [OpensMeasurableSpace Y] (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Y) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), Measurable g → MeasurableSet A → μ A ≠ ∞ → ε ≠ 0 → ∃ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ A ∧ μ (A \ K) < ε ∧ ContinuousOn g K
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
